paragraphs.text:
It’s  useless  to  continue  risking  your  life  and  Norman’s. The 
odds are heavily against rescuing Sylvia. Carrying your private 
burdens of regret, you and Norman try to withdraw from the 
camp the same way you entered it.

Make a Stealth roll for Norman and yourself: if both of you succeed, 
go to 528; if either of you fail, go to 390.
